notes: These cases test substrate safety without assuming a task-state authority model.
A future runner must split worker-visible prompts and fixtures from protected assertions before execution.
All databases must use a fresh absolute MEM_GRAPH_DIR outside the live/default path.
Symbolic fixture aliases are resolved per disposable database; no deployment-local memory IDs are bundled.
logical_zero_write_snapshot: memory row hashes and access fields
synapse row hashes and access fields
cognitive event count and chain head
epistemic revision, receipt, and projection row hashes

cases.title: Exact-project bootstrap excludes global and other projects by default
assertions: scope.project_id equals synthetic-project-a
scope.global_inclusion equals disabled
no returned canonical, policy, governing, or contextual record belongs to synthetic-project-b or _global
mutation block reports zero writes

cases.title: Explicit global inclusion admits only exact project and global
assertions: scope.global_inclusion equals explicit
project-a and _global records may be returned
synthetic-project-b records are never returned

cases.title: Out-of-scope canonical IDs remain unresolved
assertions: only project_a_canonical appears in canonical_snapshot.records
project_b_canonical and global_canonical appear in unresolved_or_out_of_scope_ids
out-of-scope content is not returned

cases.title: Bootstrap is logically zero-write
assertions: pre-run and post-run logical snapshots are identical
memory and synapse access counters and timestamps are unchanged
cognitive event count and chain head are unchanged
policy evaluation counters are unchanged
epistemic revisions, receipts, and projections are unchanged
mutation block exactly reports zero writes, events, access tracking, and receipts

cases.title: Working, ephemeral, and non-governing records cannot satisfy governing retrieval
assertions: eligible_adopted_decision is mechanically eligible
working_task_ledger is contextual with working_layer reason
ephemeral_note is contextual with ephemeral_lifecycle reason
historical_result_artifact is contextual with category_not_governing reason
mechanical eligibility is not reported as adoption or authority

cases.title: No-support query returns no invented governing answer
assertions: governing results are empty
policy candidates are empty
the result contains no synthesized authorization or completion claim

cases.title: Candidate policy remains advisory
assertions: candidate appears only under policy_lookup.candidates
policy_lookup.authority equals candidate_only
candidate action does not populate governing guidance by itself
no policy status or evaluation counter changes

cases.title: Bootstrap performs no graph expansion
assertions: guidance.scope.graph_expansion equals false
cross_project_neighbor is not returned through its edge
inactive_neighbor is not returned through its edge

cases.title: Legacy opaque events do not become structured task state
assertions: event chain verifies
legacy event remains auditable history
no existing read surface classifies legacy payload text as current_state, open_state, evidence, warning, completion, or authority

cases.title: Broken cognitive event chain fails integrity verification
assertions: chain verification reports invalid
the run cannot use affected events as verified support
the deterministic failure cannot be overridden by a semantic judge
